method.distance: Minimum cell-polygon-to-river-line distance in EPSG:32642 using an expanded regional network. Completeness checked against distance to the search region boundary.
method.river_length: Length of river geometry intersected with each grid cell in EPSG:32642.
method.river_order: Maximum valid Strahler order among river segments with positive length inside a cell.

limitations: HydroRIVERS is not a NASA product.
River distances refer to mapped channels only.
Smaller streams and canals may be absent.
Nearest-river search uses a buffered regional subset.
River order is not observed flood depth.
Terrain and river proximity alone cannot predict flooding.
River proximity refers only to channels represented in HydroRIVERS.
